# Brian Kiboi — Digital Product Builder · Remote-First, Nairobi, Kenya

## Who I am
Brian Kiboi is a remote-first digital product builder based in Nairobi, Kenya. I build fast websites, web applications, mobile apps and business platforms for clients and brands across Kenya and East Africa — combining modern design, scalability and user-focused experiences. I currently work as a Software Developer (Frontend, Mobile & UI/UX) at LogixFleet and also run my own client projects through DM Solution Tech.

## Why choose me
- Nairobi-based and remote-friendly, with clear English communication.
- End-to-end ownership: frontend, backend, testing, UI/UX and deployment.
- Shipped real products: fleet-management SaaS (ERP), e-commerce platforms, job-readiness tools, driver apps, attendance management systems.
- Experienced with payments used in East Africa: M-Pesa, Stripe, Paystack.
- DevOps-aware: Docker, CI/CD, AWS and DigitalOcean deployments.

## Services
- Custom ERP & Business Software Development — fleet management ERP, business automation and internal systems.
- Mobile App Development — Flutter / React Native for iOS & Android.
- E-commerce Development — online stores with M-Pesa, Stripe and Paystack.
- Web Development & SaaS — React, Django, Node.js business websites, dashboards and platforms.
- SEO & Website Optimization — technical SEO, structured data and Core Web Vitals.
- Personal & Professional Websites — portfolio and professional-brand sites.
- Software Maintenance & Support — updates, bug fixes, security checks and troubleshooting.
- Technology Consultancy — architecture guidance and digital-transformation advice.

## Tech stack
Python, Django, React, JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, Flutter/Dart, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, Docker, AWS, DigitalOcean, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis, Figma, Stripe, Paystack, M-Pesa.
